newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soy seen up 3-5 cents on China rumor, report.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soy seen up 3-5 cents on China rumor, report.

text.p: CBOT soybeans were expected to open three to five cents higher, lifted by rumors of Chinese interest and a report cutting the size of the Brazilian crop, traders said.
There is widespread market talk that China bought 35,000 to 40,000 tonnes of U.S. soymeal and 45,000 to 50,000 tonnes of South American soybeans overnight, traders said.
However, U.S. exporters said U.S. soymeal prices were too high, so a Chinese purchase was unlikely.
A USDA attache report from Brazil was also expected to offer futures bullish momentum.
The attache report cut the Brazilian soybean crop by more than 2 percent, shrinking it to 26.5 million tonnes because of dry weather late in the growing season.
